rule: a CHECK widened by a later migration the document never names
why: AND THE OTHER HALF OF THAT GATE: a `CHECK` a later migration widened, over a document that never says which migration did it. `30 §1` is migration 0001 verbatim and cannot be corrected to the running schema, so this is the only thing standing between a member the database enforces and nobody being able to learn it exists by reading.
